paragraphs: Derq builds intelligent transportation systems for safer roads. It sells to agencies, helping them improve safety and optimize traffic flow for all road users.

The platform detects, tracks, classifies, and predicts road user behavior in real time, and the company says it does so accurately in all weather and lighting conditions. It is compatible with a wide range of sensors, including video detection, CCTV and radar, as well as traffic controllers and V2X technologies. Edge-based traffic detection covers vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists. Analytics deliver safety insights, traffic performance data, near-miss insights, and ATSPMs. V2X applications are aimed at preventing collisions between vehicles and vulnerable road users.

Derq describes itself as an MIT spinoff founded in 2016. It says its technology is live across the United States, Canada, and the GCC. The company reports more than 20 patents. It states that it is SOC 2 Type II compliant. The site also announces that Derq was named a winner of the USDOT Intersection Safety Challenge.
